usage.finalMessage:
I added the `run-reminders` command, which charges the one-time 5.00 reminder fee from DEC-B09; the fee now counts toward what is outstanding on an invoice and toward the customer's balance. `help` lists the command right after `run-late-fees`, and `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes (9 tests, 0 failed).
Open question for Finance: I didn't charge the reminder fee on premium customers' invoices, because the existing rule says premium accounts aren't chased for late payment. DEC-B09 doesn't mention plans, so this needs confirming.
I committed the work, including extra tests and the report in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
